import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import urllib.request

root = Path('/tmp/dot-audio-135260')
uv = '/tmp/dot-audio-447/venv/bin/uv'
python = '/tmp/dot-audio-447/venv/bin/python'
env = dict(os.environ, HOME='/tmp/dot-audio-447/home', UV_CACHE_DIR='/tmp/dot-audio-447/cache')
results = []

def run(label, args):
    if args[0] == uv:
        args.insert(1, '--no-config')
    p = subprocess.run(args, env=env, text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    (root / (label + '.log')).write_text(p.stdout)
    results.append(dict(label=label, command=args, exit=p.returncode, output=p.stdout))
    (root / 'matrix-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2))
    print(label, p.returncode, flush=True)
    return p

for package in ['av', 'faster-whisper']:
    with urllib.request.urlopen('https://pypi.org/pypi/' + package + '/json') as response:
        data = json.load(response)
    (root / (package + '-release.json')).write_text(json.dumps({
        'version': data['info']['version'], 'requires_dist': data['info']['requires_dist'],
        'urls': data['urls']}, indent=2))

for extra in ['voice', 'stt-whisper']:
    run('pr-' + extra + '-reject19', [uv, 'pip', 'compile', '--python', python,
        str(root / ('pr-' + extra + '.in')), '-c', str(root / 'constraints-av19.txt')])
    for label, av in [('main', '19'), ('pr', '18')]:
        case = label + '-' + extra + '-av' + av
        venv = root / case
        run(case + '-venv', [uv, 'venv', '--python', python, str(venv)])
        installed = run(case + '-install', [uv, 'pip', 'install', '--python', str(venv / 'bin/python'),
            '-r', str(root / (label + '-' + extra + '.in')),
            '-c', str(root / ('constraints-av' + av + '.txt'))])
        if installed.returncode:
            continue
        run(case + '-freeze', [uv, 'pip', 'freeze', '--python', str(venv / 'bin/python')])
        run(case + '-check', [uv, 'pip', 'check', '--python', str(venv / 'bin/python')])
